content: Dr. Dayana K. Davidis is a medical doctor with a specialization in nutrition, as well as subspecialties in genetics and preventive medicine. She is also a certified health and wellness coach. Dr. Davidis runs clinics in multiple countries, including France and the United States, where she consults with patients either in person or virtually. She is recognized as a pioneer in integrating various diagnostic tools, such as metabolic screenings, laboratory tests, and blood work, to create personalized and preventive health plans. These plans are tailored to address existing metabolic, hormonal, or other health-related conditions, or to prevent potential health issues. Dr. Davidis completed her high school education in Switzerland. She pursued her undergraduate studies in medical dietetics, genetics, and medical sciences at AUA in Athens, Greece, and LAU in Beirut, Lebanon. She later undertook postgraduate studies in natural medicine at CPH in London, England, and health and wellness coaching at Duke University in Durham, North Carolina, USA. Throughout her career, Dr. Davidis has treated and supported thousands of patients worldwide, helping them restore their health through interventional and preventive approaches. She has also been actively involved in research focusing on nutrition, weight loss, and metabolic health. She operates medical offices in both Europe and the United States. Dr. Davidis is multilingual, with fluency in French, English, Arabic, Greek, and Spanish, and she has a working knowledge of Italian. In her personal life, she is an enthusiastic skier and enjoys hobbies such as botany, tennis, waterskiing, biking, traveling, and sightseeing. She also finds great pleasure in reading, particularly with the convenience of her e-reader.
